name: terminal
label: 终端执行
description: Run a terminal command on this machine and return the output (15s timeout by default). Dangerous commands (delete/format/shutdown, ...) are blocked by a blacklist. Use it only when it is clearly safe and necessary, preferring read-only commands (query/list/inspect).

command.description: command to run, e.g. dir / pwd / ls / git status

shell.description: shell to use (defaults to cmd on Windows, sh elsewhere)
